proof_body:
by
  intro c hc N hN
  have step : ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, c i + 1 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (m + 1), c i := by
    intro m
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    have h1 := hc (m + 1) (by omega)
    omega
  have large : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, c i := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      have h1 := step m
      omega
  have mono : ∀ x y : ℕ, x ≤ y → ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, c i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 y, c i := by
    intro x y hxy
    induction y, hxy using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact le_rfl
    | succ y _ ih =>
      have h1 := step y
      omega
  have hex : ∃ m : ℕ, N ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, c i := ⟨N, large N⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, c i < N ∧ N ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (j + 1), c i := by
    classical
    have spec := Nat.find_spec hex
    have hne : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0] at spec
      simp at spec
      omega
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hne
    have hmin : ¬ N ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, c i := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
    rw [hj] at spec
    exact ⟨j, by omega, spec⟩
  refine ⟨j + 1, ⟨by omega, by simpa using hj1, hj2⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro y ⟨hy, h3, h4⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy y (j + 1) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have h5 := mono y j (by omega)
    omega
  · exact heq
  · have h5 := mono (j + 1) (y - 1) (by omega)
    omega
target_source: ∀ c : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → 1 ≤ c i) → ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∃! m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (m - 1), c i < N ∧ N ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, c i
